requirements_summary: Workloads: conversational product assistant (chat), doc-search/semantic search, code-assist reranking
Latency target: median <= 150ms for chat tail, p95 <= 350ms under expected load
Throughput target: steady 150-200 req/s during daytime peak (burst to 350 for 30m)
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — wants predictable committed pricing with clear overage caps
Model preferences: open models (Llama variants) preferred, but willing to hybrid with proprietary weights for quality-sensitive flows
Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to lower-cost quantized variant on capacity pressure
Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS for key control, audit logging and 1y retention, EU data residency for EU customers
pricing_and_packaging_notes: Northgate looking to move from Hosted -> Dedicated for predictable unit economics as usage matures
Ask: committed GPU reservation equivalent to 2 x p4d initially, ramp to 4 x p4d over 3 months (1 -> 2 -> 4 schedule)
Burst: need ability to burst +50% capacity for 30 minutes with guaranteed priority; want 2-burst increments
Overage: request capped overage at 25% of committed capacity with blended 1.5x rate; asking for a floor to avoid huge spikes
Ramp terms: 90-day ramp, commit increases monthly tied to activity; prefer no punitive early termination on ramped GPU adds
Discount asks: multi-year vs annual — asked for stepping discounts at 12/24 month commit; also asked for Optimize add-on credit
SLA: asking for 99.95% uptime for Dedicated pools and per-request latency SLO clauses in ELA
Try-before-buy: asked for 2-week reduced-rate dedicated pilot to validate autoscaling and KV cache behavior
Metrics desired in contract: token-level cost breakdown, per-model latency percentiles, billing by committed GPU-hour and overage tokens
poC_outcomes_and_feedback: POC: Dedicated sandbox hit target latencies for chat (median 145ms) on 4k context with quantized Llama-2-7B variant
Performance: KV cache cut tail latency by ~45% for repeated session flows
Developer feedback: SDKs good, imprinting doc templates working; want more examples for batch reranking
Operational concerns: VPC peering required changes to corporate firewall; networking window estimated 2 weeks
Security review: SOC2 + SSO items green, data residency clause needs explicit EU-hosting addendum
quotes_and_call_paraphrases: CTO (J. Randle): 'We need predictability on cost — spikes hurt our margins.'
